scoring_justification: Dielectric function checked via peak location (structural audit). Elastic constants compared to paper values with tolerance and cubic stability conditions verified; this constitutes a structural-results combination because raw lower-level data (stress-strain fits) is unavailable.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference elastic constants and dielectric peak criteria from the paper
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from paper's reported elastic constants (C11, C12, C44, B0, v) and peak location descriptions.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results, serving as the hidden gold for reproduction check; not fabricated.

outputs.description: Elastic stiffness constants C11, C12, C44, bulk modulus B0, and Poisson's ratio v of cubic Al3Sc. All C values in GPa, v dimensionless.
Frequency-dependent dielectric function: real part epsilon1 and imaginary part epsilon2 vs photon energy (eV). Energy range 0–40 eV. Structural check verifies absorption peaks in epsilon2.

output_contract.notes: The partial density of states (PDOS) analysis is omitted from the scored pipeline as it is not a headline quantitative result.
